desc:
In this town, there's one rule. Break it... and you don't go home.

Every town has a story, a rule and something watching to make sure you follow it. Listen to the story, learn the rule, then make it to the end before time runs out.

🎵 Only move when the music plays.
🧱 Make it over the wall.
👁️ Don't get caught.

Break the rule and you get caught. Then you become part of the town and help hunt the others down.

FEATURES
🏘️ A different town every round, each with its own narrated story and rule
⚠️ A danger meter that shows how close you are to breaking the rule
🎬 Cinematic intros and win cutscenes
👑 Sometimes YOU are the hunter
😈 Rare emotes, daily spins and rewards
🧗 A lobby obby with coin rewards
🎁 Gift any item to your friends

Play with friends, trust no one, and remember...

In this town, the rules are everything.
